cars.specification_market: Original first-generation BK five-door Mazdaspeed3, selected 2007 US production specification from Mazda’s release dated 1 September 2006. Represent this original performance-road family once across years, grades and Mazda3 MPS / Mazdaspeed Axela aliases. Not the later BL generation, ordinary Mazda3, modern Mazda3 Turbo, Mazdaspeed6 or CX-7. No European PS output, Canadian gearbox ratios, aftermarket dealer power upgrades, test acceleration, exact cc, mass or brake diameters imported. The photo represents the original body, not proof of market, trim, condition or exact equipment.
cars.summary: The original Mazdaspeed3 brought direct-injection turbo power, a manual gearbox and limited-slip traction to Mazda’s performance-hatchback programme. Its 2007 Car and Driver 10Best recognition supports admission for its engaging, accessible performance, while acknowledging torque steer. Mazda3 MPS and Mazdaspeed Axela are regional aliases, not extra cars.
